description: File name clients give a screenshot downloaded from a remote desktop session. The rule is shared by Web, Desktop and Android so the same capture keeps the same name everywhere; each client's test suite reads this file.
rule: remote-<connectorId>-<yyyyMMddHHmmss>.<jpg|png>; the label keeps [A-Za-z0-9._-] and turns every other run of characters into '-', is trimmed of '-' and cut to 48 characters; the timestamp is the first 14 digits of capturedAt (UTC) or 'unknown'; the extension follows the format the server actually returned, PNG when absent.
